title: Partial annotation — pinned strings reserve, bare notes derive around them
description: A whole-note chord of C4 pinned to string 3 (deriving fret 5), plus bare E4 and G3. The pinned string is reserved before any assignment runs, so the bare E4 takes string 1 fret 0 and the bare G3 — whose lowest-fret home (string 3 fret 0) is taken — derives to string 4 fret 5. Annotated and unannotated notes coexist in one chord without conflict.
